title: Unit Event — Echo My Melody

meta.Outline: After putting on a successful show, Leo/need decides to start posting videos to a video platform so that their music can reach more people. Meanwhile, Ichika tries to help out the band by creating songs using digital tools, but is still struggling...

rows.Line: Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I'll try having Miku sing this...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, this isn't right either...
I'm having so much trouble getting it to sound the way I want...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sorry, Miku.
It's been a while since I decided to try making my own music, but I can't seem to produce anything good for you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki's written some really incredible songs for us already, while I...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, now's not the time for that.
I mean, I knew this wasn't going to be easy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I just have to work at my own pace until I have a song that I feel satisfied with. Then...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, we'll be able to sing together like that one time.
bgm_area00001
A few days later
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sorry I'm late, everyone.
It took longer than expected to write my entry into the class log.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Ichika, hello.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We were just watching the video of your performance at Shibuya Festa! The crowd seemed so into it! You girls have really been on fire lately!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And the show you did with anemone was absolutely astounding.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
We really gave it everything we had that time... It almost felt like each note shined, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I totally know what you mean!
Before the show, the tension felt kinda different compared to normal...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And things were completely different during it! I could hear the audience talking and stuff like always, but I was way more focused on the show itself...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You girls did practice quite a bit.
It seems that your hard work paid off.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I agree.
Some people in the crowd even said how our show was the best they'd seen in a while.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It was nice to get more of a chance to interact with them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Speaking of which, didn't you girls initially decide to play at a different live house so you could get Leo/need's name out there more?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I believe you accomplished your mission, no?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, we did.
Things have been going pretty well for us. But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can't stop. We have to keep going.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We reached the ticket quotas for our last couple shows pretty quickly, which is nice since it's clear that more people are coming to see us...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But our goal is to go pro.
Not only do we still have to become better performers, we have to keep convincing more and more people to come hear us play.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What if we played in more big events, like Shibuya Festa? That seems like an easy way to get ourselves in front of a lot of people.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's not a bad idea, but we won't have many opportunities to play at those kinds of events...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She's right... And we were only able to play at Shibuya Festa because there just happened to be one slot left when I called. It might not be so easy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
Then, do we just need to keep playing in as many shows as we can?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What's wrong, KAITO?
You look like you have something to say.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If name recognition is what you're after, I don't think you have to only do shows...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, he's right!
Shiho, you even said that there's more than one way to get people to listen to our music!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, are you referring to...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly. There are a lot of ways to go pro, but they all involve getting people to start listening to our music...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That includes playing at different live houses, starting a band account to post videos, and all sorts of other stuff...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Videos! That's it...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Does that mean we're finally gonna make an official Leo/need account?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That sounds like fun!!!
Oh, can I help! Pretty please♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we're going to need to edit our videos before uploading them, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm fine with that idea, but we'll have to give it some thought since I don't think any of us have much experience with this stuff...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, I'll try learning how.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As long as I have the software to do it, I think I can figure out how to cut, trim and edit videos for us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was also thinking about how to actually start our channel since there will probably be a process to figure out.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The videos I make may not end up being the best, but if it means even a few more people will listen to our songs, that will be worth the effort...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So...
I'd like to do what I can for this band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
...was sooo cool!
You're the best, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, Honami. We really appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not as good at this stuff as you, Honami, so I don't how much I'll be able to help. But I want to do what I can. Feel free to ask for help if you ever think you need it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you! I will!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Honami's such an amazing person...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Between putting together schedules for us and making our flyer for Shibuya Festa, she does so much for us...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Leo/need's official channel's really happening!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... But for now, we need to practice. We can talk later about how we're gonna shoot each video and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay!
I can't wait♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Especially if it means we'll be uploading all the new songs we come up with...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which means I need to write more songs that people will like!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki always seems to have so much fun writing songs for us...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(It's not that easy...
I mean, she went through a lot with that last one.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (If I can learn to write songs for us, it'll help reduce the work Saki has to do...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Unfortunately, I'm struggling to write even one that I feel satisfied with. At this rate, I won't be able to help us at all...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (For the time being, I need to finish working on my current song. I'll mention it to the others when I have something that I feel good about...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Then, I can say that I gave songwriting a try...)
The weekend
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good morning...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, no one else is here yet.
I might've left home a little too early.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I've hit a bit of a wall with my song, so it might be nice to work on it somewhere else for a change...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still... Why am I having so much trouble...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm currently writing a song with a message about helping others when they need it, but... No matter how many times I try, it ends up sounding off...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I've even tried adjusting the parts of the melody that I thought needed fixing... But that hasn't really led to an improvement in quality.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Also... I'm trying to get used to digital tools, but it isn't going well. I can't quite get the melody that's in my head...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This is a lot harder than I realized...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(But I want Miku to sing my song...
I've come this far already, so I need to at least finish it.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Still... What do I do in these situations?
I remember Saki saying...
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Let's get started, everyone!
It's time for Ms. Saki's songwriting seminar!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Woohoo!!!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, what's going on here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika was asking about how to become a better songwriter, and these two became so excited...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, Ichi!
Once again, ask me anything you like!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Okay, Ms. Saki.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She's even calling her “Ms. Saki” like she's a teacher.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are you two doing...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
S-So...
What do you do when you get stuck while writing a song? Do you have any advice regarding that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ah, excellent question.
Many things can cause you to get stuck while writing a song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: For example, if you're having trouble producing the sound you want despite having a solid image in your head, you may want to try looking at your song objectively by taking a step back.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Objectively?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Working on a song for too long can cause you to become unable to distinguish between what's good and what's bad!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, whenever you find yourself in such a situation, my... Ms. Saki's advice to you is to try listening to the song you're working on using different headphones or somewhere else entirely.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: By doing that, you might figure out what you were missing and get the hint that you need!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I never would've thought to do either of those things... Thank you very much for your advice, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're welcome!
And never stop learning!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, to be fair, I'm still pretty new to songwriting and also keep getting stuck...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Listening to it somewhere else entirely...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
This might be the perfect place...
I think I'll try that while I wait for the others to arrive.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's see... Just plug the cable into my phone and press play...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh wow... The studio's speakers sound so much cleaner... This sounds completely different compared to when I listen to it on my computer...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
The melody still sounds off...
It's not capturing that feeling of wanting to help someone who's in need...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If anything, these speakers are only making the problems more evident...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
The bass sounds...thin...
The drums sound light too. It's like everything sounds really far away...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's not just the melody. I can see now that I need to also be careful about which sounds I choose... The issues are just piling up...
What song is this?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
H-Honami?!
When did you get here?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to scare you. I should've let you know that I was here...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I-I'm also sorry.
My back was to the door, so I didn't see you come in.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
More importantly, this song... Is that Miku singing?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... So, um...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I've never heard this song before. It skipped in a few places, and the melody seems unfinished...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika... Did you write this...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, actually...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I knew it...!
You were still trying to write your own song. Not only that, you're having Miku sing it...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: B-But I really just started working on it. I mean, I can't write anything amazing like Saki!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I feel bad about making Miku sing such a half-baked song, and...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm having a lot of trouble.
Using digital tools to write songs is so hard.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you mean using a computer to write music? That's very different from how we usually produce songs...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Especially since you have to choose which instruments to use and what sounds they're going to make. It sounds tough...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I know what kind of song I want to write and have been inputting sounds based on how we usually play...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But I'm not getting what I want.
I even realized just now that my song has all these other problems with it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I thought I'd be able to help the band more if I learned to write songs for us...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What if you asked Ms. Yoisaki?
She composes songs using digital tools...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's right.
I remember her mentioning that before.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, Honami!
I'll try contacting her right away.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I sure hope she can help.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Morning!
You two are here pretty early!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You know you could've gotten started without us, right? Wait, why's only this speaker on...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... Th-The person who used it last must've forgotten!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that is pretty common!
I remember going out and leaving the air conditioner on during summer once, Tsukasa turned into a popsicle the moment he got home!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I feel like the temperature setting you chose is more the issue.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami, would you mind keeping my song a secret from the others until I've had a chance to finish it...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Partly because it's embarrassing, but mostly... I want the song to be complete when they hear it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay, I promise not to tell them.
And I'll help you when I can to make sure it turns out well.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Good job today, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Bye bye, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay...
Another day, another good practice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We even got to finalize our decision to make videos moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, which song should we do a video for first?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
We'll need to choose carefully.
Our first video's probably gonna leave the biggest impression about who we are.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right... Those who like our first video might become interested in us and even come to see us live.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, why don't we choose a song that we all feel good about and serves as a nice representation of who we are...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In other words... It'll be Leo/need's way of introducing itself to the world.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
You said it perfect, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A song that we all feel good about and serves as a nice representation of who we are... I guess that means...

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Shiho & Honami
rows.Line:
Saki's song!
The song Saki wrote!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! You all landed on the same answer!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It seems like the right choice for our first video since we practiced so much just to play it during that show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And it means something special to me. All of you working hard to master it compelled me to play with everything I had...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: S-Saki, is that okay with you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Of course!
I can't believe it'll be our first video... I mean, I worked super hard on it, so this makes me really happy♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. For now, until we do our shoot, let's keep practicing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Unlike shows, videos last forever...
And that comes with a different sort of anxiety...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll need to practice a lot for it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm? Did someone just send me a message?
A few days later
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello, Ms. Yoisaki.
Thank you for having me over again today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for coming again, Ms. Mochizuki. Also...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Welcome, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for agreeing to help me today. After I suddenly asked you to teach me about digital music tools too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Not only that, you even invited me to your house.
I feel kind of bad about all of this...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's my pleasure.
I mean, I happen to have the equipment you need for this.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, however, the house may be a bit of a mess since Ms. Mochizuki hasn't had a chance to clean it yet...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Don't worry. It'll be clean in no time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, if you'll excuse me, I'll get started.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Good luck, Ichika.
And thank you again, Ms. Yoisaki. I hope you two can make some good progress.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Me too.
Anyway, shall we head up to my room...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes!
Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh wow! So much equipment...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Did you buy all of these, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, my dad used to be in the music business, so most of them originally belonged to him...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Your dad...?
I see.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, if I had this much equipment, I wouldn't know where to begin...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Actually, you'd be surprised...
More often than not, I end up using the same ones.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll try something different when I want to achieve a different sound... But I definitely have my favorites since I don't seem to mix well with some of them...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Interesting...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Anyway, Hoshino, what would you like to ask me? About how to create a melody? Or about using software...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, right. Um... I'm having several issues, but I'd like to start by asking you to listen to my song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I just need one second to open it on my computer...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's about what I have right now.
No matter how hard I try, I can't produce the sound I have in my head...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When I played it through one of the speakers at the rehearsal studio we rented the other day, I noticed that it lacked so much depth... I really don't know where to begin fixing it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, Hoshino, I hadn't realized that you were having Miku sing your song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, that's right.
I like Miku a lot... And I want to write songs with her if I'm going to do this seriously...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um... I mean I want to make them using Miku!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. I see.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That reminds me of how we first met...
We were both hoping to listen to that one creator's new song which also featured Miku!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, there are so many songs that make Miku's voice sound so beautiful on top of being well put together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
I really admire the people who can produce those kinds of Miku songs.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I'm having so much trouble now that I'm trying to write my own song...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Up until now, I've been listening to all these Miku songs made by a variety of people with different feelings... And they've all been wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which is why I want to try doing that myself now. Unfortunately, things haven't been going very well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I just want to let her singing voice shine, so I feel terrible about how I've been making her sing such an incomplete song...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
I think you deserve more credit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, it's a bit hard to clearly see what your song is about... However, I did sense a hint of kindness. Like this song was encouraging me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You mentioned how you weren't getting the sound you wanted.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That also means you know exactly what you want from your song, so I think all you have to do is keep working on it with that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... Can I ask specifically what kind of song you're trying to write?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What kind of song...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
The thing is...
I'm writing this song because I want some people I care about very much to listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: People you care about very much...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. So, I put a lot of thought into what kind of song they'd like to hear...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Something that gives them the courage to change themselves and move forward...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Something that'll be a source of support when they're facing their pain to go beyond their limits...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Something that tells them that they don't have to hold back when I know they're capable of so much more, and that I'll catch up to them someday...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to write a song that gently encourages those who I care about most...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
...
A song that gently encourages them...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hadn't thought of saving others like that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I understand what you want now.
Now, about the instruments you wish to include...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Do you plan on playing this song as Leo/need once it's complete?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, that's the plan...!
I tried choosing sounds based on the instruments that we all play...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But it sounded so off when I listened to it. I began doubting myself as to how we usually sound...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The guitar sounded fine to me, but the other instruments don't quite seem to fit into your song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I knew it...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I didn't have much trouble with the guitar since I play it, but for the rest I could only rely on how everyone else sounds while playing their instruments...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. That may partly explain why you're not getting what you're looking for, since just a few different sounds can greatly change the overall feel of a song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want to say that experience is also important... But that won't exactly help you right now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, for now, let's try coming up with a way to make it sound more balanced...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
...!
I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I'd like to start taking a closer look. It should be easier to see everything on my computer since it has bigger screens. So, I'll just send the file to myself...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Alright, it's open.
I'll mute everything except the drums.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's amazing...!
You really know what you're doing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
This is nothing special.
I just moved a few things around on the screen.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
We'll start working on your song now...
First, let's listen to how the drums sound...
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
This is the closest it's sounded to what I initially imagined...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Kanade

To be fair, it's not exactly easy to find a diamond in the rough. In terms of that...

Leo/need...
